reviews.text: Not worth it. I downloaded this because I thought it was free but it has been trying to charge my account. I also didn’t subscribe to it but it was showing that it was a subscription so I unsubscribed to it before it was to be renewed and was still charged. I did like it up until it charged my account.
Practical learning aid. I like that it explains the logic behind the solutions instead of just giving the final answer. It’s been a consistent tool for better understanding algebraic concepts.

Passed Stats with A. I’m not taking stats for a 3rd time lol finally passed! Definitely helps you learn and pass, the people who help you are very kind and fast! A bunch of geniuses. Mike, Alice, Nadin, and I’m missing a few other have been great help. Very smart people and I am thankful for them❤️ The bad reviews are lies 😂 nothing is bad about this app. I’m not smart with math and I have an A! Thanks to them I can move on with my life and on to what truly matters and applies to my career. Glitches happen people! Upgrade to expert advice to minimize delays. I never experienced a single issue with the expert advice.
Thank you. The best I ever had love them

Best App for Math. The way they break down a problem and help you understand it it’s amazing, experts always willing to help and answer any questions you might be having trouble with great app recommended !!!

Helped me pass Calculus. App was great for the majority of the course but struggled with higher level graph based questions. No issues with photo quality like others have said. All said and done I got a B. Good enough for a gen. ed. that I don’t care about!
Ethan. Ethan is super helpful, very knowledgeable and polite. Hid answers we’re all correct and he responded quickly and promptly. Thank you for all your help !
